types.name: BODMAS and brackets
types.description: A plain arithmetic expression with brackets, "of", division, multiplication, addition and subtraction to be evaluated in the right order.

types.name: Fractions and decimals
types.description: Simplifying or comparing fractions, mixed numbers, decimals or recurring decimals, or arranging fractions in order.

types.name: Powers and indices
types.description: Uses laws of exponents to simplify powers, negative or fractional powers, or to solve an equation where the unknown is in the power.

types.name: Surds and square roots
types.description: Involves square or cube roots: simplifying, rationalising a denominator, finding √(a + 2√b), or comparing roots of different orders.

types.name: Infinite roots and continued fractions
types.description: An infinite nested root such as √(20 − √(20 − ...)) or a fraction inside a fraction (ladder or continued fraction) to be evaluated or solved.

types.name: Using algebraic identities
types.description: A numerical or algebraic expression that becomes easy using identities such as a² − b², (a + b)², a³ + b³ or a³ − b³.

types.name: Approximation and missing value
types.description: Asks for an approximate value of a messy expression, or for the value of x that makes two sides of a percent or arithmetic equation equal.

types.name: Series that cancel and quick sums
types.description: A long sum of terms like 1/(n(n + 1)), 1/(√n + √(n + 1)) or powers of a number that simplifies by cancelling or a sum formula.
